interfaces.Governance_Rule: Design identity, ratings and configuration remain source-owned; AIP stores governed references and applicability.
Only approved revision may activate a model rule.
Site/asset override allowed only when approved and versioned.
AIP evaluates evidence; source telemetry remains in historian/SCADA.
Detection confidence is not treated as overall engineering fit.
RCM chooses policy; engineering model verifies condition mechanism; ERP/EAM executes approved work.
AIP does not become transactional system of record.
